description: Lays 2 to 10 Google Business Profiles side by side and measures how far the first falls behind the rest. Use it when the user names their competitors; use local_scan to find who actually ranks. keyword adds each business's Maps rank. It works in the user's own Chrome through the Local SEO extension, opening Google Maps in a background tab, and fails with a message saying how to connect when the extension is not connected. Nothing is written to Google. Returns rows in the order given (position is that order; name, ids, categories, rating, reviewCount, photoCount, website, phone, claimed, address; each null when unknown), gap (competitors, missingCategories, primarySharedBy, and reviews, rating and photos each as target, competitorMedian, difference and known, null where a side is unknown; and summary sentences) and ranks (null without keyword). A rank is {kind: "ranked", rank}, {kind: "not_found", depth} (the list was read to depth organic results, as many as Maps listed up to the cap, and the business was not there, which is not rank 0), or {kind: "unknown", reason} (the point could not be read, or Maps cut its list short, so the business may sit just past it).

businesses.description: 2 to 10 businesses, each {mapsUrl}, {placeId}, {cid} or {name, city}. The first is the one the gap is measured for.

mapsUrl.description: A Google Maps link to the place, such as https://maps.app.goo.gl/... .

placeId.description: A Google place id, such as "ChIJ...".

cid.description: A Google customer id (CID), decimal digits, as in maps.google.com/?cid=.

city.description: The town or city it is in, such as "Leeds, UK".

name.description: The business name as Google shows it.

items.description: Which business: exactly one of {mapsUrl}, {placeId}, {cid} or {name, city}. Ids from find_business or local_scan are exact; a name and city is searched in Maps and can match a different place with the same name.

keyword.description: A search to rank them all for, from the first business's location, such as "emergency plumber". Defaults to none, which leaves ranks null.

name: compare_businesses
title: Compare businesses
